# ZAVIKOO Custom Atelier

> ZAVIKOO Custom Atelier is a Karachi clothing studio offering oversized graphic T-shirts, winter hoodies, and custom garment designs, with delivery across Pakistan.

## Confirmed business facts

- brandName: ZAVIKOO Custom Atelier
- city: Karachi
- region: Sindh
- country: Pakistan
- serviceArea: Pakistan

- returnWindowDays: 7
- returnConditions: Ready-made items may be exchanged within 7 days of delivery if unworn, unwashed, undamaged, and with tags and original packaging.
- exchangePolicy: Ready-made items are eligible for exchange only. The customer pays the delivery charge for the exchange. Errors or defects are resolved at no cost to the customer.
- customReturnPolicy: Customised items cannot be returned or exchanged for change of mind. Errors or defects on the studio’s side are corrected.
